title: Benchmark of regr.L0Learn
text: first data set simulated: 200 rows, 50 features, first 5 features non-zero coefficient. second real Boston housing data MASS package (506 rows, 13 numeric features), target median home value.
code: set.seed(1) n_rows <- 200 n_features <- 50 x_mat <- matrix(   rnorm(n_rows * n_features), n_rows, n_features,   dimnames = list(NULL, sprintf("x%02d", seq_len(n_features)))) y_vec <- as.numeric(x_mat[, 1:5] %*% rep(2, 5) + rnorm(n_rows)) sparse_task <- as_task_regr(   data.frame(y = y_vec, x_mat), target = "y", id = "sparse") boston_task <- as_task_regr(MASS::Boston, target = "medv", id = "Boston") task_list <- list(boston_task, sparse_task)

title: Benchmark of regr.L0Learn
code: knn_tuner <- auto_tuner(   tuner = tnr("grid_search"),   learner = lrn("regr.kknn", k = to_tune(1, 30)),   resampling = rsmp("cv", folds = 3),   measure = msr("regr.mse")) knn_tuner$id <- "tuned_kknn" learner_list <- list(   lrn("regr.L0Learn", nFolds = 5L),   lrn("regr.featureless"),   lrn("regr.cv_glmnet"),   knn_tuner)

title: Benchmark of regr.L0Learn
code: set.seed(1) bench_grid <- benchmark_grid(task_list, learner_list, rsmp("cv", folds = 5)) bench_result <- benchmark(bench_grid) score_dt <- bench_result$score(msr("regr.mse")) score_dt[, .(mean_mse = mean(regr.mse), sd_mse = sd(regr.mse)),   by = .(task_id, learner_id)] #>    task_id       learner_id   mean_mse     sd_mse #>     <char>           <char>      <num>      <num> #> 1:  Boston     regr.L0Learn 27.3156722 12.3689881 #> 2:  Boston regr.featureless 84.6229527 15.3779285 #> 3:  Boston   regr.cv_glmnet 26.6650639 13.7971665 #> 4:  Boston       tuned_kknn 18.9266167  7.7502699 #> 5:  sparse     regr.L0Learn  0.7850789  0.1845453 #> 6:  sparse regr.featureless 24.2370484  8.7235604 #> 7:  sparse   regr.cv_glmnet  0.8768506  0.3407752 #> 8:  sparse       tuned_kknn 17.7060683  5.7213560 ggplot(score_dt, aes(x = regr.mse, y = learner_id)) +   geom_point() +   facet_grid(. ~ task_id, scales = "free") +   labs(x = "Test mean squared error (5-fold cross-validation)", y = "Algorithm") +   theme_bw()

title: Benchmark of regr.L0Learn
text: L0 penalization designed give sparse models. table counts features non-zero coefficient learner trained rows data set.
code: count_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(task_list, function(task) {   l0 <- lrn("regr.L0Learn", nFolds = 5L)$train(task)   glmnet_learner <- lrn("regr.cv_glmnet")$train(task)   data.table(     task_id = task$id,     n_features = length(task$feature_names),     L0Learn = length(l0$selected_features()),     cv_glmnet = length(glmnet_learner$selected_features())) })) count_dt #>    task_id n_features L0Learn cv_glmnet #>     <char>      <int>   <int>     <int> #> 1:  Boston         13       3         7 #> 2:  sparse         50       8         9

what: mlr3 Learner for L0-Regularized Regression via L0Learn
title: mlr3 Learner for L0-Regularized Regression via L0Learn
text: Documentation: https://mlr3l0learn.netlify.app mlr3L0Learn adds regression learner best subset selection mlr3 framework. wraps L0Learn::L0Learn.cvfit(), fits sparse linear models L0, L0L1 L0L2 penalties using coordinate descent local combinatorial search (Hazimeh Mazumder, 2020).

title: mlr3 Learner for L0-Regularized Regression via L0Learn
mlr3 Learner for L0-Regularized Regression via L0Learn
text: Loading package registers learner regr.L0Learn mlr3 learner dictionary. penalty strength lambda (gamma "L0L1" "L0L2" penalties) chosen cross-validation inside L0Learn::L0Learn.cvfit(). pair smallest cross-validated error used prediction. L0Learn::L0Learn.cvfit() split every number rows every number folds: fails, returns NaN errors, ceiling(n / nFolds) * (nFolds - 1) >= n. example default nFolds = 10 work 32 rows mtcars. learner reports informative error, pass another nFolds. Training change global random number generator state. cross-validation folds controlled seed parameter. benchmark regr.featureless, regr.cv_glmnet tuned k-nearest neighbors learner vignette:
code: library(mlr3) library(mlr3L0Learn)  task <- tsk("mtcars") learner <- lrn("regr.L0Learn", penalty = "L0", nFolds = 5L) learner$train(task) learner$selected_features()  prediction <- learner$predict(task) prediction$score(msr("regr.mse")) vignette("benchmark", package = "mlr3L0Learn")

what: Regression Learner for L0-Regularized Best Subset Selection — LearnerRegrL0Learn
title: Regression Learner for L0-Regularized Best Subset Selection — LearnerRegrL0Learn
text: Sparse linear regression L0, L0L1 L0L2 penalties, fitted coordinate descent local combinatorial search L0Learn::L0Learn.cvfit(). penalty parameters lambda gamma chosen cross-validation inside L0Learn::L0Learn.cvfit(), pair smallest mean cross-validated error stored model used prediction. loss always squared error. Features must "integer" "numeric", missing values supported L0Learn.

title: Regression Learner for L0-Regularized Best Subset Selection — LearnerRegrL0Learn
text: parameters tag "train" passed L0Learn::L0Learn.cvfit(), except selection, used learner . Parameters set explicitly keep defaults L0Learn. nGamma, gammaMax gammaMin matter "L0L1" "L0L2" penalties.

title: Regression Learner for L0-Regularized Best Subset Selection — LearnerRegrL0Learn
text: folds built L0Learn::L0Learn.cvfit(), split every number rows n every number folds nFolds. ceiling(n / nFolds) * (nFolds - 1) >= n either fails --bounds error returns NaN cross-validation errors. example nFolds = 10 fails 32 rows mlr3::tsk("mtcars"). learner stops informative error, another value nFolds must chosen.

title: Regression Learner for L0-Regularized Best Subset Selection — LearnerRegrL0Learn
text: L0Learn::L0Learn.cvfit() calls set.seed(seed). learner restores state random number generator training, fitting change random numbers drawn afterwards. cross-validation folds given seed, whose default 1.

title: Regression Learner for L0-Regularized Best Subset Selection — LearnerRegrL0Learn
text: selection = "min" (default) learner uses pair smallest mean cross-validated error. several values tied, one furthest along lambda path (smallest lambda, usually largest support) used. selection = "1se" learner keeps gamma minimum, takes model lambda path smallest support among whose mean cross-validated error within one standard error minimum. standard error standard deviation fold errors minimum divided sqrt(nFolds). available minimum used, warning. usually gives smaller support stable choice features.

title: Regression Learner for L0-Regularized Best Subset Selection — LearnerRegrL0Learn
text: lows highs single numbers bound every coefficient, lows <= 0 <= highs lows < highs. Bounds supported algorithm = "CDPSI". lambdaGrid list strictly decreasing positive numeric vectors. penalty = "L0" must contain exactly one vector, "L0L1" "L0L2" contains one vector per value gamma. set, nLambda ignored L0Learn nGamma replaced number vectors. L0Learn can drop last values grid whose support exceeds maxSuppSize, stored path may shorter grid. excludeFirstK larger number features, L0Learn abort R session.

title: Regression Learner for L0-Regularized Best Subset Selection — LearnerRegrL0Learn
text: training, learner$model list elements: fit: "L0LearnCV" object returned L0Learn::L0Learn.cvfit(). gamma_index, lambda_index: position selected pair regularization path fit. lambda, gamma: selected values. support_size: number non-zero coefficients selected model. cv_mean, cv_sd: mean standard deviation, across folds, cross-validated error selected pair.

title: Regression Learner for L0-Regularized Best Subset Selection — LearnerRegrL0Learn
text: learner$selected_features() returns names features non-zero coefficient selected (lambda, gamma) pair.

title: mlr3L0Learn 0.1.0
text: New parameter selection: "min" (default) keeps pair smallest cross-validated error, "1se" picks sparsest model within one standard error minimum. model now stores support_size, cv_mean cv_sd selected pair. New parameters lows, highs lambdaGrid, explicit errors combinations L0Learn support. Errors L0Learn::L0Learn.cvfit() reported message. advice change nFolds given fold splitting failure.
